model_name: Moonscape Lunar South Pole Optical Hazard Detector

dataset.source: LROC NAC (Narrow Angle Camera) / Chandrayaan-2 OHRC polar orbital frames
dataset.val_regions: Malapert Mountain Summit Massif & Haworth Rim (Artemis Site 02)
dataset.test_regions: de Gerlache Crater Rim 1 & 2 (Candidate Artemis Sites 03 & 04 - Zero Geographic Leakage)

operational_limitations.apollo_domain_warning: Apollo surface photography (sun elevation > 15 deg, astronaut eye-level view) is invalid for orbital nadir crater/boulder mapping. This model was trained and evaluated strictly on high-resolution polar orbital imagery with grazing sun angles (solar incidence 78°-84.5°).
operational_limitations.permanently_shadowed_regions: Optical detection fails in zero-illumination Permanently Shadowed Regions (PSRs). DEM LiDAR roughness, slope, and radar backscatter must be used inside PSRs.
operational_limitations.safety_critical_disclaimer: Intended for preliminary candidate site screening and mission planning only. NOT certified for autonomous real-time landing descent or human-rated hazard avoidance.
